description: OpenAI gpt-oss 20B MoE via Ollama: fast local reasoning model with tool calling; text-only.
notes: NOT INSTALLED: pull with `ollama pull gpt-oss:20b`. Download 14GB (20.9B MoE (~3.6B active), MXFP4 default tag), needs ~16GB RAM plus KV cache; fits the 48GB M4 Max. Library context 128K; limit set to 131072 because Ollama sizes context from VRAM (assumes OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH raised). OpenAI model card: SWE-bench Verified ~60.7% (high reasoning), Codeforces Elo ~2516 with tools, GPQA ~71.5%; native MXFP4 so no extra quant penalty. Rated between glm-4.5-air (5.2) and glm-4.7 (6.5). Reasoning effort configurable. Q4 quantization already accounted for. Latency estimated for M4 Max 48GB by scaling measured gemma4:26b (78 tok/s, ~4B active) by active-weight bytes; not measured. Thinking is on by default: pass think=false for fast answers. Native MXFP4 weights (not Q4). 120b exists (65GB) but does not fit comfortably in 48GB; not carded. Page checked 2026-10-25.
